events.comment: Character selection. Left/Right/Up/Down, the mouse and the D-pad move over FERNANDO, FINN, RAE, BARBARA, START and BACK. Enter / A / a click on a character jumps to START.
START: Yes / No animations play for a moment, then the screen fades to black and the game starts.

inlineCode: // Models: all idle; the chosen one grows and waves once when the choice changes. START: the chosen one says Yes, the others No (both loop).
const S = runtimeScene.__charSel || (runtimeScene.__charSel = { prev: -1, started: false });
const cur = o.__s || base, target = base * (chosen ? 1.15 : 1);
else if (chosen && o.getAnimationName() === 'Wave' && o.hasAnimationEnded && o.hasAnimationEnded()) o.setAnimationName('Idle');
// Selected character: its name keeps the player colour, and a ring of particles is under its feet. Single player = player 1 (blue).
for (const b of runtimeScene.getObjects(bn)) if (b.getVariables().get('Index').getAsNumber() === sel) b.setColor(colStr);
for (const n of NAMES) for (const o of runtimeScene.getObjects(n)) if (o.getVariables().get('Index').getAsNumber() === sel) target = o;
// normal blending (the menu background is almost white, additive blue would vanish on it); sprites keep their size in world units
group.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.05, 12, 72), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false, fog: false })));
const sp = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, color: col, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false, fog: false }));
for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) parts.push({ age: Math.random(), life: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8, a: Math.random() * 6.2832, r: 0.92 + Math.random() * 0.16, rise: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
S.ring = { ts, group, sprites, parts, axis: new THREE.Vector3(), first: true, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
// feet: x/y of the model origin, z = the soles
// the layer's three scene is mirrored on Y (like the 2D axes): the model is read in world space, the ring is placed in the scene's own space
const wp = R.wp || (R.wp = new THREE.Vector3()), cl = R.cl || (R.cl = new THREE.Vector3());

// the origin is in the middle of the body: go down to the soles: 0.73 of the distance to the bottom of the vertex box (measured once, per unit of scale; the box reaches ~35% below the visible soles, found by eye in the preview)
if (isFinite(bx.min.z) && bx.max.z - bx.min.z > 1) target.__feetK = 0.73 * (wp.z - bx.min.z) / sc;
wp.z -= target.__feetK !== undefined ? target.__feetK * sc : 0.36 * target.getDepth();
const tx = wp.x, ty = wp.y, tz = wp.z;
if (R.first) { R.x = tx; R.y = ty; R.z = tz; R.first = false; }
else { const k = Math.min(1, dt * 10); R.x += (tx - R.x) * k; R.y += (ty - R.y) * k; R.z += (tz - R.z) * k; }
// tilt the ring toward the camera (a camera at floor level would see a flat ring as a line)
const hx = cl.x - R.x, hy = cl.y - R.y, hl = Math.hypot(hx, hy) || 1;
if (p.age >= 1) { p.age = 0; p.life = 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8; p.a = Math.random() * 6.2832; p.r = 0.92 + Math.random() * 0.16; p.rise = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.5; }
sp.position.set(Math.cos(a) * p.r, Math.sin(a) * p.r, p.age * p.rise);
const target = norm("Pistol"); // ime noda pistolja u modelu
